data.title: Inihaw na Liempo (Good for 2)
data.meals: Half-kilo pork belly marinated overnight in calamansi, soy sauce and lemongrass, grilled over coconut husk charcoal. Served with garlic rice, atchara and spiced vinegar dip.
data.rule: Price is good for 2-3 persons. Available for dine-in and takeaway. Full payment is required before queueing; unused vouchers are refundable within the validity period.
